```{r setup, include=FALSE}
missing_packages <- required_packages[

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)

tf_names <- c("NAC1", "NAC11")

publication_dir <- here("Data", "data_for_publication", "DAPseq_validation")
dapseq_dir <- file.path(publication_dir, "inputs", "DAPseq")
output_dir <- publication_dir

table_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")

dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

normalize_gene_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  sub("^MtrunA17(?=(Chr|CP|MT))", "MtrunA17_", x, perl = TRUE)
}
```

# Load DAP-seq peaks and define 1 kb promoter targets

NAC11 is the historical input label for MtNAC47. Promoter targets require a
promoter-annotated peak strictly less than 1 kb from the transcription start site.

```{r load-input-data}
dapseq_files <- setNames(
  file.path(dapseq_dir, paste0(tf_names, "_annotated3.csv")), tf_names
)
missing_input_files <- dapseq_files[!file.exists(dapseq_files)]
if (length(missing_input_files) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing required input file(s): ", paste(missing_input_files, collapse = ", "))
}
dapseq_data <- imap(dapseq_files, function(path, tf_name) {
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(TF = tf_name, geneId_original = as.character(geneId),
           geneId = normalize_gene_id(geneId)) %>% relocate(TF)
})
dapseq_all <- bind_rows(dapseq_data)
promoter_targets_under_1kb <- imap_dfr(
  dapseq_data,
  function(peak_table, tf_name) {
    peak_table %>%
      filter(
        str_detect(as.character(annotation), regex("^Promoter", ignore_case = TRUE)),
        !is.na(distanceToTSS),
        abs(as.numeric(distanceToTSS)) < 1000,
        !is.na(geneId),
        geneId != ""
      ) %>%
      transmute(TF = tf_name, geneId) %>%
      distinct()
  }
)

```
```{r prepare-go-annotation, include=FALSE}
go_pairs_file <- file.path(publication_dir, "inputs", "annotation", "GO_gene_pairs_MtrunA17r5.tsv")
if (!file.exists(go_pairs_file)) {
  stop("GO annotation file is missing: ", go_pairs_file)
}

go_pairs <- read_tsv(
  go_pairs_file,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    geneId = normalize_gene_id(LOCUS_TAG),
    GO = as.character(GO)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(geneId),
    geneId != "",
    !is.na(GO),
    GO != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(geneId, GO)

GO2genes <- split(go_pairs$geneId, go_pairs$GO)
go_universe <- sort(unique(go_pairs$geneId))

parse_topgo_pvalue <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(
    str_detect(x, "^<"),
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_remove(x, "^<"))),
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  )
}

```
# Proportion of DAP-seq peaks in genomic regions

Each peak is counted once in the genomic feature stored in its `annotation`
column. Gene-specific exon and intron calls are collapsed to Exon and Intron.
Downstream peaks are those annotated as `Downstream (<=300bp)`. NAC11 is shown
as MtNAC47.

```{r plot-dapseq-peak-genomic-regions, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.2}
genomic_region_levels <- c(
  "Promoter",
  "5' UTR",
  "Exon",
  "Intron",
  "3' UTR",
  "Downstream (<=300 bp)",
  "Distal intergenic"
)

assign_genomic_region <- function(annotation) {
  annotation <- as.character(annotation)
  case_when(
    str_detect(annotation, regex("^Promoter", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Promoter",
    str_detect(annotation, regex("^5' UTR", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "5' UTR",
    str_detect(annotation, regex("^Exon", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Exon",
    str_detect(annotation, regex("^Intron", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Intron",
    str_detect(annotation, regex("^3' UTR", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "3' UTR",
    str_detect(annotation, regex("^Downstream", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
      "Downstream (<=300 bp)",
    str_detect(annotation, regex("^Distal Intergenic", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
      "Distal intergenic",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

peak_genomic_regions <- dapseq_all %>%
  mutate(
    genomic_region = assign_genomic_region(annotation),
    TF_label = recode(
      TF,
      "NAC1" = "MtNAC1",
      "NAC11" = "MtNAC47"
    )
  )

unknown_region_count <- sum(is.na(peak_genomic_regions$genomic_region))
if (unknown_region_count > 0L) {
  unknown_annotations <- peak_genomic_regions %>%
    filter(is.na(genomic_region)) %>%
    distinct(annotation) %>%
    pull(annotation)
  stop(
    "Unassigned genomic-region annotation(s): ",
    paste(head(unknown_annotations, 10), collapse = "; ")
  )
}

peak_genomic_region_counts <- peak_genomic_regions %>%
  count(TF, TF_label, genomic_region, name = "peak_count") %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  mutate(
    total_peaks = sum(peak_count),
    proportion = peak_count / total_peaks,
    percentage = 100 * proportion
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    TF_label = factor(TF_label, levels = c("MtNAC1", "MtNAC47")),
    genomic_region = factor(genomic_region, levels = genomic_region_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(TF_label, genomic_region) %>%
  group_by(TF_label) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(proportion),
    ymin = ymax - proportion,
    label_y = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
    label_color = if_else(
      genomic_region %in% c("Promoter", "Intron", "3' UTR"),
      "white",
      "grey20"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

if (any(abs(tapply(
  peak_genomic_region_counts$proportion,
  peak_genomic_region_counts$TF,
  sum
) - 1) > 1e-8)) {
  stop("Genomic-region proportions do not sum to 1 for every TF.")
}

write_csv(
  peak_genomic_region_counts %>%
    mutate(
      TF_label = as.character(TF_label),
      genomic_region = as.character(genomic_region)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      TF,
      TF_label,
      genomic_region,
      peak_count,
      total_peaks,
      proportion,
      percentage
    ),
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_DAPseq_peak_genomic_region_proportions.csv"
  )
)

peak_genomic_region_plot <- ggplot(
  peak_genomic_region_counts,
  aes(x = as.numeric(TF_label), fill = genomic_region)
) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = as.numeric(TF_label) - 0.31,
      xmax = as.numeric(TF_label) + 0.31,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = label_y,
      label = if_else(
        proportion >= 0.04,
        sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage),
        ""
      ),
      color = label_color
    ),
    size = 3.1,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(levels(peak_genomic_region_counts$TF_label)),
    labels = levels(peak_genomic_region_counts$TF_label),
    expand = expansion(add = 0.65)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%"),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Promoter" = "#E64B35",
      "5' UTR" = "#F39B7F",
      "Exon" = "#4DBBD5",
      "Intron" = "#3C5488",
      "3' UTR" = "#00A087",
      "Downstream (<=300 bp)" = "#8491B4",
      "Distal intergenic" = "#B8B8B8"
    ),
    name = "Genomic region",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of DAP-seq peaks in genomic regions",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of peaks"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_DAPseq_peak_genomic_region_proportions.png"
  ),
  peak_genomic_region_plot,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 5.2,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_DAPseq_peak_genomic_region_proportions.pdf"
  ),
  peak_genomic_region_plot,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 5.2,
  bg = "white"
)

peak_genomic_region_plot
knitr::kable(
  peak_genomic_region_counts %>%
    mutate(
      percentage = round(percentage, 1)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      TF = TF_label,
      `Genomic region` = genomic_region,
      Peaks = peak_count,
      `Percentage` = percentage
    ),
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r"),
  caption = "DAP-seq peaks assigned to each genomic region"
)
```

# Overlap of 1 kb promoter targets

Unique genes with a promoter-annotated DAP-seq peak strictly less than 1 kb
from the transcription start site are compared between MtNAC1 and MtNAC47.
A gene with several qualifying peaks is counted once per TF.

```{r venn-promoter-targets-under-1kb, fig.width=6.4, fig.height=5.4}
nac1_promoter_1kb <- promoter_targets_under_1kb %>%
  filter(TF == "NAC1") %>%
  pull(geneId) %>%
  unique()
nac47_promoter_1kb <- promoter_targets_under_1kb %>%
  filter(TF == "NAC11") %>%
  pull(geneId) %>%
  unique()

promoter_1kb_only_nac1 <- setdiff(nac1_promoter_1kb, nac47_promoter_1kb)
promoter_1kb_only_nac47 <- setdiff(nac47_promoter_1kb, nac1_promoter_1kb)
promoter_1kb_shared <- intersect(nac1_promoter_1kb, nac47_promoter_1kb)

promoter_1kb_overlap_genes <- tibble(
  geneId = union(nac1_promoter_1kb, nac47_promoter_1kb),
  in_MtNAC1 = geneId %in% nac1_promoter_1kb,
  in_MtNAC47 = geneId %in% nac47_promoter_1kb
) %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_group = case_when(
      in_MtNAC1 & in_MtNAC47 ~ "Shared",
      in_MtNAC1 ~ "MtNAC1 only",
      in_MtNAC47 ~ "MtNAC47 only"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(overlap_group, geneId)

promoter_1kb_overlap_summary <- promoter_1kb_overlap_genes %>%
  count(overlap_group, name = "gene_count") %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_group = factor(
      overlap_group,
      levels = c("MtNAC1 only", "Shared", "MtNAC47 only")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(overlap_group) %>%
  mutate(
    MtNAC1_promoter_targets = length(nac1_promoter_1kb),
    MtNAC47_promoter_targets = length(nac47_promoter_1kb)
  )

write_csv(
  promoter_1kb_overlap_genes,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_promoter_under_1kb_overlap_genes.csv"
  )
)
write_csv(
  promoter_1kb_overlap_summary %>%
    mutate(overlap_group = as.character(overlap_group)),
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_promoter_under_1kb_overlap_summary.csv"
  )
)

circle_angle <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 361)
promoter_venn_circles <- map_dfr(
  c("MtNAC1", "MtNAC47"),
  function(set_name) {
    center_x <- if (set_name == "MtNAC1") 0.90 else 1.50
    tibble(
      set = set_name,
      point_order = seq_along(circle_angle),
      x = center_x + 0.72 * cos(circle_angle),
      y = 1 + 0.72 * sin(circle_angle)
    )
  }
)

promoter_venn_counts <- tibble(
  overlap_group = c("MtNAC1 only", "Shared", "MtNAC47 only"),
  gene_count = c(
    length(promoter_1kb_only_nac1),
    length(promoter_1kb_shared),
    length(promoter_1kb_only_nac47)
  ),
  x = c(0.55, 1.20, 1.85),
  y = 1
)

promoter_venn_set_labels <- tibble(
  set_label = c(
    paste0("MtNAC1\n(n = ", length(nac1_promoter_1kb), ")"),
    paste0("MtNAC47\n(n = ", length(nac47_promoter_1kb), ")")
  ),
  x = c(0.55, 1.85),
  y = 1.86,
  color = c("#D95F02", "#7570B3")
)

promoter_1kb_venn_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = promoter_venn_circles,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = set, fill = set),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.42
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = promoter_venn_counts,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = gene_count),
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = promoter_venn_set_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = set_label, color = color),
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "MtNAC1" = "#D95F02",
      "MtNAC47" = "#7570B3"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  coord_equal(
    xlim = c(0.05, 2.35),
    ylim = c(0.18, 2.08),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Overlap of 1 kb promoter targets",
    subtitle = "Unique genes with a promoter peak <1 kb from the TSS"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 8, 12)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_promoter_under_1kb_venn.png"
  ),
  promoter_1kb_venn_plot,
  width = 6.4,
  height = 5.4,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_promoter_under_1kb_venn.pdf"
  ),
  promoter_1kb_venn_plot,
  width = 6.4,
  height = 5.4,
  bg = "white"
)

promoter_1kb_venn_plot
knitr::kable(
  promoter_1kb_overlap_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(
      `Overlap` = overlap_group,
      `Genes` = gene_count
    ),
  align = c("l", "r"),
  caption = "Unique 1 kb promoter targets shared by MtNAC1 and MtNAC47"
)
```

# Prepare GRN target sets

The unique DAP-seq promoter targets within 1 kb are compared with the target
genes assigned to the same TF in the shoot consensus GRN top 3% edge list.

```{r compare-promoter-targets-with-grn-top3pct, include=FALSE}
grn_top3pct_file <- file.path(publication_dir, "inputs", "consensus_network_deg_tf_top3pct_edges.csv")
if (!file.exists(grn_top3pct_file)) {
  stop("GRN top 3% edge file is missing: ", grn_top3pct_file)
}

tf_grn_ids <- tibble(
  TF = c("NAC1", "NAC11"),
  TF_label = c("MtNAC1", "MtNAC47"),
  regulatoryGene = c(
    "MtrunA17_Chr2g0312321",
    "MtrunA17_Chr7g0252971"
  )
)

grn_top3pct_edges <- read_csv(
  grn_top3pct_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

required_grn_columns <- c("regulatoryGene", "targetGene")
missing_grn_columns <- setdiff(
  required_grn_columns,
  names(grn_top3pct_edges)
)
if (length(missing_grn_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing required GRN column(s): ",
    paste(missing_grn_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

grn_targets_top3pct <- grn_top3pct_edges %>%
  transmute(
    regulatoryGene = normalize_gene_id(regulatoryGene),
    geneId = normalize_gene_id(targetGene)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(tf_grn_ids, by = "regulatoryGene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(geneId), geneId != "") %>%
  distinct(TF, TF_label, regulatoryGene, geneId)

missing_grn_tfs <- setdiff(tf_names, unique(grn_targets_top3pct$TF))
if (length(missing_grn_tfs) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "No top 3% GRN targets were found for: ",
    paste(missing_grn_tfs, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

dap_promoter_targets_for_grn <- promoter_targets_under_1kb %>%
  distinct(TF, geneId) %>%
  left_join(
    tf_grn_ids %>%
      dplyr::select(TF, TF_label, regulatoryGene),
    by = "TF"
  )

dap_grn_target_membership <- full_join(
  dap_promoter_targets_for_grn %>%
    transmute(
      TF,
      TF_label,
      regulatoryGene,
      geneId,
      in_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb = TRUE
    ),
  grn_targets_top3pct %>%
    transmute(
      TF,
      TF_label,
      regulatoryGene,
      geneId,
      in_GRN_top3pct = TRUE
    ),
  by = c("TF", "TF_label", "regulatoryGene", "geneId")
) %>%
  mutate(
    in_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb = coalesce(
      in_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb,
      FALSE
    ),
    in_GRN_top3pct = coalesce(in_GRN_top3pct, FALSE),
    comparison_group = case_when(
      in_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb & in_GRN_top3pct ~
        "Shared DAP-seq and GRN",
      in_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb ~ "DAP-seq only",
      in_GRN_top3pct ~ "GRN only"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(TF, tf_names), comparison_group, geneId)

dap_grn_overlap_summary <- dap_grn_target_membership %>%
  group_by(TF, TF_label, regulatoryGene) %>%
  summarise(
    DAPseq_promoter_targets_under_1kb =
      sum(in_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb),
    GRN_top3pct_targets = sum(in_GRN_top3pct),
    shared_targets = sum(
      in_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb & in_GRN_top3pct
    ),
    union_targets = n(),
    jaccard_index = shared_targets / union_targets,
    percent_DAPseq_targets_in_GRN =
      100 * shared_targets / DAPseq_promoter_targets_under_1kb,
    percent_GRN_targets_in_DAPseq =
      100 * shared_targets / GRN_top3pct_targets,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dap_grn_plot_data <- dap_grn_target_membership %>%
  count(TF, TF_label, comparison_group, name = "gene_count") %>%
  mutate(
    TF_label = factor(TF_label, levels = c("MtNAC1", "MtNAC47")),
    comparison_group = factor(
      comparison_group,
      levels = c(
        "DAP-seq only",
        "Shared DAP-seq and GRN",
        "GRN only"
      )
    )
  )

write_csv(
  grn_targets_top3pct,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_GRN_top3pct_target_genes.csv"
  )
)
write_csv(
  dap_grn_target_membership,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb_vs_GRN_top3pct_gene_membership.csv"
  )
)
write_csv(
  dap_grn_overlap_summary,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb_vs_GRN_top3pct_overlap_summary.csv"
  )
)

```
# GO enrichment of DAP-seq promoter targets within 1 kb

GO Biological Process enrichment is run separately for MtNAC1 and MtNAC47
using every unique DAP-seq target gene with a promoter-annotated peak strictly
less than 1 kb from the transcription start site. The background is the full
Medicago GO annotation universe. Enrichment uses topGO's classic Fisher test.
Benjamini–Hochberg correction is applied across every tested term, and terms
with adjusted p < 0.05 are called significant.

```{r go-enrichment-dapseq-promoter-targets-under-1kb}
dap_promoter_go_gene_tables <- promoter_targets_under_1kb %>%
  distinct(TF, geneId) %>%
  left_join(
    tf_grn_ids %>% dplyr::select(TF, TF_label),
    by = "TF"
  ) %>%
  group_split(TF, TF_label) %>%
  set_names(
    map_chr(
      .,
      ~ unique(.x$TF)
    )
  )

missing_dap_promoter_go_tfs <- setdiff(
  tf_names,
  names(dap_promoter_go_gene_tables)
)
if (length(missing_dap_promoter_go_tfs) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "No DAP-seq promoter targets under 1 kb were found for: ",
    paste(missing_dap_promoter_go_tfs, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

run_dap_promoter_go <- function(target_table, tf_name) {
  tf_label <- unique(target_table$TF_label)
  query_genes <- intersect(
    unique(target_table$geneId),
    go_universe
  )

  if (length(query_genes) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No ",
      tf_label,
      " DAP-seq promoter targets occur in the GO universe."
    )
  }

  gene_list <- factor(
    as.integer(go_universe %in% query_genes),
    levels = c(0, 1)
  )
  names(gene_list) <- go_universe

  go_data <- methods::new(
    "topGOdata",
    ontology = "BP",
    allGenes = gene_list,
    geneSel = function(x) x == "1",
    annot = topGO::annFUN.GO2genes,
    GO2genes = GO2genes,
    nodeSize = 5
  )

  fisher_result <- topGO::runTest(
    go_data,
    algorithm = "classic",
    statistic = "fisher"
  )

  result_table <- topGO::GenTable(
    go_data,
    Fisher = fisher_result,
    orderBy = "Fisher",
    ranksOf = "Fisher",
    topNodes = length(topGO::score(fisher_result)),
    numChar = 200
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      TF = tf_name,
      TF_label = tf_label,
      promoter_target_gene_count =
        n_distinct(target_table$geneId),
      genes_in_go_universe = length(query_genes),
      Fisher_pvalue = parse_topgo_pvalue(Fisher),
      padj = p.adjust(Fisher_pvalue, method = "BH"),
      Significant_num = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(Significant)
      ),
      Expected_num = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(Expected)
      ),
      FoldEnrichment = if_else(
        is.finite(Expected_num) & Expected_num > 0,
        Significant_num / Expected_num,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    relocate(
      TF,
      TF_label,
      promoter_target_gene_count,
      genes_in_go_universe
    ) %>%
    arrange(Fisher_pvalue)

  significant_table <- result_table %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

  safe_tf_label <- str_replace_all(
    tf_label,
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    "_"
  )
  write_csv(
    result_table,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(
        safe_tf_label,
        "_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb_topGO_BP.csv"
      )
    )
  )
  write_csv(
    significant_table,
    file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(
        safe_tf_label,
        "_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb_",
        "topGO_BP_significant.csv"
      )
    )
  )

  list(
    GOdata = go_data,
    test = fisher_result,
    results = result_table,
    significant = significant_table,
    query_genes = query_genes
  )
}

dap_promoter_go_results <- imap(
  dap_promoter_go_gene_tables,
  ~ run_dap_promoter_go(.x, .y)
)

all_dap_promoter_go_results <- bind_rows(

all_significant_dap_promoter_go_results <- bind_rows(
```

## Venn diagrams: DAP-seq versus GRN targets

```{r dap-grn-venn-plots}
venn_groups <- c(
  "DAP-seq only",
  "Shared DAP-seq and GRN",
  "GRN only"
)

venn_plot_data <- tibble(
  TF = rep(tf_names, each = length(venn_groups)),
  comparison_group = rep(venn_groups, times = length(tf_names))
) %>%
  left_join(
    dap_grn_target_membership %>%
      count(TF, comparison_group, name = "gene_count"),
    by = c("TF", "comparison_group")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tf_grn_ids %>% dplyr::select(TF, TF_label),
    by = "TF"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_count = coalesce(gene_count, 0L),
    label_x = case_when(
      comparison_group == "DAP-seq only" ~ 0.55,
      comparison_group == "Shared DAP-seq and GRN" ~ 1.20,
      comparison_group == "GRN only" ~ 1.85
    ),
    label_y = 1
  )

circle_angle <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 361)
venn_circle_data <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(tf_grn_ids)),
  function(i) {
    current_tf <- tf_grn_ids[i, ]
    map_dfr(
      c("DAP-seq promoter <1 kb", "GRN top 3%"),
      function(set_name) {
        center_x <- if (
          set_name == "DAP-seq promoter <1 kb"
        ) 0.90 else 1.50

        tibble(
          TF_label = current_tf$TF_label,
          set = set_name,
          point_order = seq_along(circle_angle),
          x = center_x + 0.72 * cos(circle_angle),
          y = 1 + 0.72 * sin(circle_angle)
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

venn_set_labels <- map_dfr(
  tf_grn_ids$TF_label,
  ~ tibble(
    TF_label = .x,
    set_label = c("DAP-seq\npromoter <1 kb", "GRN\ntop 3%"),
    x = c(0.55, 1.85),
    y = c(1.82, 1.82)
  )
)

dap_grn_venn_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = venn_circle_data,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      group = interaction(TF_label, set),
      fill = set
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.42
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = venn_plot_data,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = gene_count),
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = venn_set_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = set_label),
    size = 3.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ TF_label) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "DAP-seq promoter <1 kb" = "#2C7FB8",
      "GRN top 3%" = "#BDBDBD"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  coord_equal(
    xlim = c(0.08, 2.32),
    ylim = c(0.18, 2.02),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "DAP-seq promoter targets versus shoot GRN targets",
    subtitle = "Numbers represent unique genes"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb_vs_GRN_top3pct_venn.png"
  ),
  dap_grn_venn_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb_vs_GRN_top3pct_venn.pdf"
  ),
  dap_grn_venn_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## Annotated DAP-seq and GRN intersection

The exported table contains every gene shared by the DAP-seq promoter target
set under 1 kb and the shoot consensus GRN top 3% target set. It includes
curated gene names and products, DAP-seq promoter-peak evidence, and GRN
ranking metrics. Transient-expression results are not included.

```{r annotate-dapseq-grn-intersection, include=FALSE}

annotation_summary_file <- file.path(publication_dir, "inputs", "annotation", "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.summary.tsv")
curated_gene_names_file <- file.path(publication_dir, "inputs", "annotation", "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.gene_names.tsv")

missing_annotation_files <- c(
  annotation_summary_file,
  curated_gene_names_file
)
missing_annotation_files <- missing_annotation_files[
  !file.exists(missing_annotation_files)
]
if (length(missing_annotation_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing gene annotation file(s): ",
    paste(missing_annotation_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

summary_gene_annotation <- read_tsv(
  annotation_summary_file,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    geneId = normalize_gene_id(LOCUS_TAG),
    summary_gene_name = na_if(GN, ""),
    summary_gene_product = na_if(PRODUCT, "")
  ) %>%
  distinct(geneId, .keep_all = TRUE)

curated_gene_annotation <- read_tsv(
  curated_gene_names_file,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    geneId = normalize_gene_id(locus_tag),
    curated_gene_name = na_if(acronym, ""),
    curated_gene_product = na_if(geneProduct, "")
  ) %>%
  distinct(geneId, .keep_all = TRUE)

intersection_gene_annotation <- full_join(
  summary_gene_annotation,
  curated_gene_annotation,
  by = "geneId"
) %>%
  transmute(
    geneId,
    GeneName = coalesce(
      curated_gene_name,
      summary_gene_name,
      ""
    ),
    GeneProduct = coalesce(
      summary_gene_product,
      curated_gene_product,
      ""
    )
  )

intersection_dap_evidence <- dapseq_all %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      as.character(annotation),
      regex("^Promoter", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ),
    !is.na(distanceToTSS),
    abs(as.numeric(distanceToTSS)) < 1000,
    !is.na(geneId),
    geneId != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(TF, geneId) %>%
  summarise(
    DAPseq_promoter_peak_count_under_1kb = n(),
    DAPseq_closest_peak_distance_to_TSS = distanceToTSS[
      which.min(abs(distanceToTSS))
    ],
    DAPseq_minimum_absolute_distance_to_TSS =
      min(abs(distanceToTSS)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

required_grn_annotation_columns <- c(
  "regulatoryGene",
  "targetGene",
  "CLR_Rank",
  "genie3_Rank",
  "aracne_Rank",
  "outpredict_Rank",
  "GeoMeanRank"
)
missing_grn_annotation_columns <- setdiff(
  required_grn_annotation_columns,
  names(grn_top3pct_edges)
)
if (length(missing_grn_annotation_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing GRN annotation column(s): ",
    paste(missing_grn_annotation_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

intersection_grn_evidence <- grn_top3pct_edges %>%
  transmute(
    regulatoryGene = normalize_gene_id(regulatoryGene),
    geneId = normalize_gene_id(targetGene),
    CLR_Rank = as.numeric(CLR_Rank),
    genie3_Rank = as.numeric(genie3_Rank),
    aracne_Rank = as.numeric(aracne_Rank),
    outpredict_Rank = as.numeric(outpredict_Rank),
    GeoMeanRank = as.numeric(GeoMeanRank)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    tf_grn_ids %>%
      dplyr::select(TF, regulatoryGene),
    by = "regulatoryGene"
  ) %>%
  group_by(TF, regulatoryGene, geneId) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(GeoMeanRank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

annotated_dap_grn_intersection <- dap_grn_target_membership %>%
  filter(in_DAPseq_promoter_under_1kb, in_GRN_top3pct) %>%
  dplyr::select(TF, TF_label, regulatoryGene, geneId) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(
    intersection_gene_annotation,
    by = "geneId"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    intersection_dap_evidence,
    by = c("TF", "geneId")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    intersection_grn_evidence,
    by = c("TF", "regulatoryGene", "geneId")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GeneName = coalesce(GeneName, ""),
    GeneProduct = coalesce(GeneProduct, "")
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    GeneName,
    GeneProduct,
    .after = geneId
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    match(TF, tf_names),
    geneId
  )

write_csv(
  annotated_dap_grn_intersection,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "DAPseq_GRN_intersection_annotated.csv"
  )
)

intersection_annotation_summary <- annotated_dap_grn_intersection %>%
  count(TF, TF_label, name = "annotated_intersection_genes")

knitr::kable(intersection_annotation_summary)
```

# Co-expression direction of GRN targets

Co-expression direction is estimated only for MtNAC1 and MtNAC47. For every
target assigned to these TFs in the top 3% GRN, Pearson correlation is
calculated between TF and target expression across the VST-transformed shoot
RNA-seq samples. P values are adjusted separately for each TF across all of its
tested GRN targets before the DAP-seq/GRN intersection is selected.

Positive and negative labels indicate co-expression direction; they do not by
themselves prove direct activation or repression.

```{r infer-grn-target-coexpression-direction}
shoot_wgcna_rds <- file.path(publication_dir, "inputs", "ShootWGCNA_objects.rds")
if (!file.exists(shoot_wgcna_rds)) {
  stop("Shoot WGCNA object is missing: ", shoot_wgcna_rds)
}

shoot_wgcna_object <- readRDS(shoot_wgcna_rds)
shoot_expression <- shoot_wgcna_object$datExpr

if (
  !is.matrix(shoot_expression) &&
    !is.data.frame(shoot_expression)
) {
  stop("The Shoot WGCNA object does not contain a valid datExpr matrix.")
}

shoot_expression <- as.matrix(shoot_expression)
colnames(shoot_expression) <- normalize_gene_id(
  colnames(shoot_expression)
)

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(shoot_expression)) > 0L) {
  stop("Gene ID normalization produced duplicate expression columns.")
}

requested_tf_ids <- tf_grn_ids %>%
  filter(TF %in% c("NAC1", "NAC11"))

missing_expression_tfs <- requested_tf_ids$regulatoryGene[
  !requested_tf_ids$regulatoryGene %in% colnames(shoot_expression)
]
if (length(missing_expression_tfs) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "TF gene(s) missing from the shoot expression matrix: ",
    paste(missing_expression_tfs, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

grn_edges_for_direction <- grn_targets_top3pct %>%
  semi_join(
    requested_tf_ids,
    by = c("TF", "TF_label", "regulatoryGene")
  ) %>%
  distinct(TF, TF_label, regulatoryGene, geneId)

correlate_tf_target <- function(
  TF,
  TF_label,
  regulatoryGene,
  geneId
) {
  if (!geneId %in% colnames(shoot_expression)) {
    return(
      tibble(
        TF = TF,
        TF_label = TF_label,
        regulatoryGene = regulatoryGene,
        geneId = geneId,
        n_samples = NA_integer_,
        expression_correlation = NA_real_,
        correlation_pvalue = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  tf_expression <- as.numeric(
    shoot_expression[, regulatoryGene]
  )
  target_expression <- as.numeric(
    shoot_expression[, geneId]
  )
  complete_samples <- complete.cases(
    tf_expression,
    target_expression
  )
  sample_count <- sum(complete_samples)

  if (
    sample_count < 3L ||
      stats::sd(tf_expression[complete_samples]) == 0 ||
      stats::sd(target_expression[complete_samples]) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      tibble(
        TF = TF,
        TF_label = TF_label,
        regulatoryGene = regulatoryGene,
        geneId = geneId,
        n_samples = sample_count,
        expression_correlation = NA_real_,
        correlation_pvalue = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  correlation_test <- stats::cor.test(
    tf_expression[complete_samples],
    target_expression[complete_samples],
    method = "pearson"
  )

  tibble(
    TF = TF,
    TF_label = TF_label,
    regulatoryGene = regulatoryGene,
    geneId = geneId,
    n_samples = sample_count,
    expression_correlation = unname(correlation_test$estimate),
    correlation_pvalue = correlation_test$p.value
  )
}

grn_target_directions <- pmap_dfr(
  grn_edges_for_direction,
  correlate_tf_target
) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  mutate(
    correlation_padj = p.adjust(
      correlation_pvalue,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    coexpression_direction = case_when(
      !is.na(correlation_padj) &
        correlation_padj < 0.05 &
        expression_correlation > 0 ~ "Positive co-expression",
      !is.na(correlation_padj) &
        correlation_padj < 0.05 &
        expression_correlation < 0 ~ "Negative co-expression",
      TRUE ~ "Undetermined"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    match(TF, tf_names),
    correlation_padj,
    desc(abs(expression_correlation))
  )

write_csv(
  grn_target_directions,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "MtNAC1_MtNAC47_GRN_top3pct_coexpression_direction.csv"
  )
)

annotated_intersection_with_direction <-
  annotated_dap_grn_intersection %>%
  left_join(
    grn_target_directions %>%
      dplyr::select(
        TF,
        regulatoryGene,
        geneId,
        n_samples,
        expression_correlation,
        correlation_pvalue,
        correlation_padj,
        coexpression_direction
      ),
    by = c("TF", "regulatoryGene", "geneId")
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    match(TF, tf_names),
    factor(
      coexpression_direction,
      levels = c(
        "Positive co-expression",
        "Negative co-expression",
        "Undetermined"
      )
    ),
    correlation_padj,
    geneId
  )

write_csv(
  annotated_intersection_with_direction,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    paste0(
      "DAPseq_GRN_intersection_annotated_",
      "with_coexpression_direction.csv"
    )
  )
)

direction_levels <- c(
  "Positive co-expression",
  "Negative co-expression",
  "Undetermined"
)

intersection_direction_summary <- tibble(
  TF = rep(tf_names, each = length(direction_levels)),
  coexpression_direction = rep(
    direction_levels,
    times = length(tf_names)
  )
) %>%
  left_join(
    annotated_intersection_with_direction %>%
      count(
        TF,
        coexpression_direction,
        name = "target_gene_count"
      ),
    by = c("TF", "coexpression_direction")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    requested_tf_ids %>%
      dplyr::select(TF, TF_label),
    by = "TF"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    target_gene_count = coalesce(target_gene_count, 0L)
  ) %>%
  group_by(TF, TF_label) %>%
  mutate(
    total_intersection_genes = sum(target_gene_count),
    percentage = 100 *
      target_gene_count / total_intersection_genes
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    TF_label = factor(
      TF_label,
      levels = c("MtNAC1", "MtNAC47")
    ),
    coexpression_direction = factor(
      coexpression_direction,
      levels = direction_levels
    )
  )

write_csv(
  intersection_direction_summary %>%
    mutate(
      TF_label = as.character(TF_label),
      coexpression_direction = as.character(
        coexpression_direction
      )
    ),
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "DAPseq_GRN_intersection_coexpression_direction_summary.csv"
  )
)

make_intersection_direction_plot <- function(tf_name) {
  plot_data <- intersection_direction_summary %>%
    filter(
      TF == tf_name,
      coexpression_direction %in% c(
        "Positive co-expression",
        "Negative co-expression"
      )
    ) %>%
    droplevels()

  tf_label <- unique(as.character(plot_data$TF_label))

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = coexpression_direction,
      y = target_gene_count,
      fill = coexpression_direction
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.62,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = ifelse(
          target_gene_count > 0,
          paste0(
            target_gene_count,
            "\n(",
            sprintf("%.1f", percentage),
            "%)"
          ),
          ""
        )
      ),
      vjust = -0.45,
      size = 3.9,
      lineheight = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Positive co-expression" = "#D73027",
        "Negative co-expression" = "#4575B4",
        "Undetermined" = "#BDBDBD"
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c(
        "Positive co-expression" = "Positive",
        "Negative co-expression" = "Negative"
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.16))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = tf_label,
      subtitle = paste(
        "Pearson correlation; BH-adjusted P < 0.05;",
        "percentages use all intersection genes"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Target genes"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

intersection_direction_plots <- setNames(
  map(tf_names, make_intersection_direction_plot),
  c("MtNAC1", "MtNAC47")
)

iwalk(
  intersection_direction_plots,
  function(plot_object, tf_label) {
    file_stem <- paste0(
      "DAPseq_GRN_intersection_coexpression_direction_",
      tf_label
    )

    ggsave(
      file.path(figure_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".png")),
      plot_object,
      width = 5.8,
      height = 5.5,
      dpi = 600,
      bg = "white"
    )
    ggsave(
      file.path(figure_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".pdf")),
      plot_object,
      width = 5.8,
      height = 5.5,
      bg = "white"
    )

    print(plot_object)
  }
)

knitr::kable(
  intersection_direction_summary %>%
    mutate(
      TF_label = as.character(TF_label),
      coexpression_direction = as.character(
        coexpression_direction
      )
    ),
  digits = 1
)
```
